measurement_source.scope: Prepared BF16 Q/pooled K; common MLX compiled-graph submit/evaluate envelope. Score and score+fixed256-radix. Source-body adapters, not production ICB or full engine runtimes.

model: Synthetic BF16 Q [T,4,128], pooled K [G,128], ratio=4, top_k=512
metric: Median wall-clock microseconds per invocation, common MLX compiled-graph envelope
scope: Source-body controls. Projection, pooling, page construction, layout preparation and compilation excluded. Score_radix uses the same full256 exact selector for every arm. Not production Metal replay or complete engine performance.
swap_verdict: All completed cases have equal before/after Swapins and Swapouts counters. Failed attempts excluded.
